# Sol Next — Full Technical & Product Reference (v9.1.1-public, Build 911)

## 1. Executive Summary
Sol Next is an open-source (Apache-2.0), zero-cost Android & HarmonyOS AI personal assistant and autonomous mobile phone agent created by Zhang Chongyang (许昌北海医院张重阳). Unlike web wrappers or chat-only assistants, Sol Next combines:
1. A pure native Jetpack Compose Material 3 dual-mode experience (`Chat` + `Task`) with Light (`#FFFFFF`) and Obsidian Dark (`#0E0F11`) themes at up to 120Hz.
2. Zero-config built-in DeepSeek Flash (default low thinking effort for ultra-fast responses, switchable to DeepSeek Pro high effort or custom API Key / Subscription OAuth models).
3. Built-in real-time Brave Search REST API (encrypted in the native Rust vault with automatic CN Bing fallback for mainland China without VPN) powering both everyday chat grounding and multi-hop Deep Research.
4. A bundled 4-stage on-device realtime neural voice system (GTCRN denoiser -> Silero VAD v5 -> Zipformer-CTC ASR -> AISHELL-3 VITS TTS) requiring zero external cloud voice API keys.
5. Hands-free offline Notification Voice Readout for driving and resting with Audio Ducking and automatic OTP/financial number redaction.
6. A background independent 1:1 Virtual Display with `DISPLAY_IME_POLICY_HIDE` keyboard isolation, live mid-task steering, precision click grounding, and OEM Accessibility self-healing.

## 2. Architecture Breakdown

### 2.1 Dual-Mode Execution (`Chat | Task`)
- **Chat Mode (`对话`)**: Pure conversational Q&A, structured Markdown writing, code analysis, multi-hop Deep Research, and automatic real-time Brave web grounding. Zero screen-overlay interference.
- **Task Mode (`任务`)**: Keeps the exact clean conversational UI while pulling up Sol Next's in-app Background Independent Virtual Display (`SolDualDisplayDriver` + `SolBgShellService`). Uses `DISPLAY_IME_POLICY_HIDE (2)` so secondary-display input boxes never collapse the user's keyboard on Display 0. Supports live in-loop steering (`steerCurrent`), simultaneous voice steering, 30-step collapsible execution audit logs, and sensitive-operation confirmation dialogs (payments, WeChat sends, system settings).

### 2.2 Built-In 4-Stage On-Device Neural Voice Pipeline
Bundled directly inside `assets/sol_neural_voice/` and `lib/arm64-v8a/libsherpa-onnx-jni.so`:
- Stage 1: `denoiser/gtcrn_simple.onnx` (535 KB) — real-time neural speech enhancement and road/wind noise suppression.
- Stage 2: `vad/silero_vad_v5.onnx` (2.31 MB) — `<100ms` Voice Activity Detection and instant barge-in interruption.
- Stage 3: `asr/model.int8.onnx` (26.3 MB) — Zipformer-CTC quantized streaming bilingual speech recognition.
- Stage 4: `tts/model.onnx` (30.5 MB) — AISHELL-3 VITS offline neural text-to-speech synthesis.
Powers: Full-screen Live Voice, Simultaneous Voice Bar, AI Phone Calls (dialing, auto-answering, real-time anti-scam alerts, 1-tap human takeover), and Hands-Free Notification Readout.

### 2.3 Model Management, Subscription OAuth & BYOK
- Built-in defaults: `DeepSeek Flash` (low thinking effort) and `DeepSeek Pro` (high thinking effort), dynamically applied on every request with zero app restart.
- Subscription OAuth: Real OpenRouter OAuth 2.0 PKCE (`S256`) with automatic `solnext://auth/model-openrouter` deep-link callback, plus GitHub Models/Copilot, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, and SiliconFlow presets.
- All user-supplied API keys and OAuth tokens are encrypted at rest via Android Keystore AES-256-GCM.

### 2.4 Security & Cryptographic Verification
- **Rust 2024 Native Kernel (`libsol_kernel.so`)**: 16KB page-aligned for Android 15/16. Uses ChaCha20 + Encrypt-then-MAC HMAC-SHA256 + HKDF-SHA256 to seal built-in credentials bound to package name (`ai.sol.next`) and APK Signature Scheme v2/v3 certificate SHA-256 (`d7a6fed0ff42843a20329944f2b1741060048610546df6cf2ad8179cfe335478`), with procfs anti-debug/anti-Frida checks. Zero plaintext keys in Git or APK.
- **Privacy Firewall**: Automatic on-device redaction of ID numbers, bank cards, and secrets prior to cloud LLM transmission.
- **OEM Accessibility Optimization**: Persists one-time onboarding completion so MIUI/HyperOS, ColorOS, OriginOS, and HarmonyOS users are never stuck in repetitive Accessibility re-prompt loops after swiping away the app; automatically self-heals Accessibility in 200ms when Shell Helper is connected.
